next.reason: 1985: "data description entries whose level-number is 01 in the File Section or the Working-Storage Section"; 2023: "a) A constant entry. b) ...file, working-storage, local-storage, or linkage section. c) A screen-description entry whose level-number is 1.". 2023 also permits GLOBAL in constant entries, level-1 local-storage and linkage entries, and level-1 screen description entries, which the 1985 rule refused.
